splashSequence.reducedMotion: Every step lands as its end state through an m-dur-2 crossfade; no draws, pulses, slides or dock travel.
splashSequence.model: Pure function of time: progress = clamp((t - cue) / duration) through a named easing; play, skip and freeze render the same frame.
gpuiPorting: No general transforms: animate absolute offsets for slides, the capsule dock and pane arrivals.
Animate quad width/height for the progress seam and the workspace seams drawing from their ends.
Compute truncated polylines for line draws (walk the segment list to the current length) instead of dash offsets.
Opacity for fades; one Animation per element.

narrative.overview:
Hacivat is a dense, quiet working surface for people who spend hours inside databases and sometimes touch production. The ground is graphite, panels are one step lighter, and everything is separated by single-pixel seams rather than cards, gaps or floating chrome. Colour is not decoration: every hue on screen answers a question (where am I, can I write, is the path direct, is something pending, what is selected). Production is the one signal allowed to shout, and it shouts exactly once, in the title-bar capsule.

Density is deliberate. Rows are 21 to 23px, toolbars 24 to 34px, the type ramp lives between 11 and 15px, and all numbers sit on tabular figures so columns of data align without effort. Source Sans 3 carries the interface; Fragment Mono carries code, identifiers, data types and measurements. Section labels use true small caps, never uppercase-with-tracking on body text.

The light theme is a calm macOS white rather than an inversion of the dark one: white content panes, #F7F7F8 chrome, near-black ink, and deeper, more saturated semantic hues that hold contrast on white. The production capsule fill is identical in both themes so the signal never changes weight when the theme does. Shadow-theatre heritage appears only in the product name and the logo; the logo in the build is an explicit placeholder (dashed frame with an H monogram) and is not part of the system.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite tiles separated by 1px seams; no cards, no floating chrome except popovers.
Hue reserved for meaning: red production, green direct path and success, amber pending, blue selection and focus.
Exactly one filled production badge per window.
Source Sans 3 + Fragment Mono, tabular numerals everywhere, small-caps section labels.
Radii of 3, 4 and 6px on controls and surfaces; tiny marks are square; elevation reserved for popovers.
Lucide icons at 1.6 stroke, 12px in chrome, 14px default.
No ambient motion in the workspace; one choreographed connect sequence on the splash.

rules.name: The One Filled Badge Rule
rules.body: Exactly one filled production badge exists per window: the cp-fill block in the title-bar capsule. Every other production occurrence is a 7px swatch, a lock icon, a 1px hairline, a tinted status segment, or plain red text.

rules.name: The Hue Is Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red, green, amber and blue are never used decoratively. If an element is coloured, it must answer "which environment", "which path", "what is pending" or "what is selected".

rules.name: The Raised Ink Rule
rules.body: Tertiary ink (text-3) never sits on the raised surface: dark text-3 reaches only 4.18:1 on raised #252931. Metadata on raised toolbars, active tabs, the next-page strip and popovers uses text-2.

rules.name: The Same Weight Rule
rules.body: The capsule fill and its white text are identical in dark and light themes.

rules.name: The Tabular Everywhere Rule
rules.body: Every text run uses tabular figures. Numbers in quantities and measures are formatted by the UI locale (en-US: 1,240.00; tr-TR: 1.240,00), right-aligned in grid and inspector. Identifiers and keys (ids, foreign keys) render raw. Copy and export always use raw, unformatted values.

rules.name: The Mono Means Copyable Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono marks text that is literal: SQL, identifiers, types, connection names, timings and counts. Prose and UI labels stay in Source Sans 3.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below 11px, including key hints, inlays and column-type subtitles.

rules.name: The Real Small Caps Rule
rules.body: Section labels use the font's small-caps features with 0.075em tracking at weight 600, never uppercased body text.

rules.name: The Status Follows The Tab Rule
rules.body: The status bar's environment, access and rows/timing segments, the result toolbar, the inspector and the next-page strip all follow the active result tab. Switching from a production result to a staging result swaps them together; the title-bar capsule continues to describe the editor's connection.

rules.name: The Overflow Rule
rules.body: Toolbars collapse trailing actions into an overflow menu when width runs short, before any label truncates or wraps. Turkish strings fit the 1440px reference with about 3px to spare, so any narrower window or longer locale depends on this.

rules.name: The Popover-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only floating surfaces that appear above the workspace cast a shadow. Panels, toolbars, tabs and buttons never do.

rules.name: The Pure Function Of Time Rule
rules.body: The splash is a cue sheet: every property is computed from elapsed time as clamp((t - cue) / duration) through a named easing, so play, skip and freeze all render the same frame. Port one animation per element with that delta.

dos: **Do** keep exactly one filled production badge (the capsule); express production elsewhere with swatches, lock icons, the 1px editor hairline, the tinted status segment or plain red text.
**Do** name the write target on every staging action ("Submit to orders-staging", "Delete selected rows from orders-staging", "Runs on orders-staging in one transaction").
**Do** format quantities by UI locale (en-US / tr-TR) and copy or export raw values.
**Do** make the status bar, result toolbar, inspector and next-page strip follow the active result tab.
**Do** collapse toolbar actions into an overflow menu when narrow, and test every surface in Turkish.
**Do** separate regions with 1px seams and tone steps; keep radii to 3, 4 and 6px.
**Do** use Lucide at 1.6 stroke, 12px in chrome and 14px default.
**Do** use text-2, not text-3, for metadata on the raised surface.
**Do** drive splash motion only from the motion tokens, and keep a crossfade fallback for reduced motion.
**Do** isolate destructive actions with space and a seam, outline-only until hover or focus.
donts: **Don't** add a second filled environment badge anywhere, including tabs, tree rows or the status bar.
**Don't** use semantic hues decoratively or introduce a fifth accent outside syntax highlighting.
**Don't** put shadows on panels, toolbars, tabs or buttons; shadows belong to popovers.
**Don't** wrap content in shadowed cards or float chrome other than popovers; bordered insets (DML preview, boot panel) stay flat.
**Don't** treat the placeholder logo as final, or extend shadow-theatre heritage beyond the name and the logo.
**Don't** add ambient motion to the workspace.
**Don't** render text below 11px or put a radius on marks smaller than 8px.
**Don't** use proportional figures or uppercase-with-tracking in place of small caps.
